summary.text: Rachael Hawkins-Church is the Democratic candidate for the West Virginia House of Delegates, District 35, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a former DJ and Southern West Virginia mother.

paragraphs.text: Rachael Hawkins-Church earned a high school diploma from Pineville High School, and Ballotpedia lists her career experience as working in business management.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she is not a politician and is tired of seeing the same candidates run.
Hawkins-Church faces Republican John Morgan in the general election, in a race with no incumbent.
Her survey answers named clean water, support for unions and more healthy activities for children as her key messages, and clean water legislation as her policy interest.
